visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a beige sleeveless mock-neck top and denim shorts, sits cross-legged in a neutrally lit living room. She smiles broadly while holding a fan of purple blind box packets. Behind her is a plain off-white wall with a framed minimalist line-art picture. (2) Close-up shots show the woman’s hands holding individual purple Hololive-themed packets, detailing character illustrations and logos. The lighting remains bright and consistent, emphasizing the product colors. (3) The woman begins tearing open the packets with precise hand movements. She pulls out translucent plastic cards with purple borders and anime character art. Her facial expressions shift between anticipation and delight as she reveals each one. (4) The scene shifts to a first-person perspective (POV) showing the woman’s hands tapping a group-shot card against a yellow and blue electronic subway gate sensor. The setting is a clean, well-lit metro station with tiled floors. (5) A screen recording interface appears, displaying the green and white layout of a retail mobile app with various icons and a map. (6) Back in the indoor setting, the woman holds up two specific character cards toward the camera, pointing at them while gesturing with her head. Yellow subtitles appear consistently at the bottom of the frame.
